svg.text: Science Corp (Khosla list) and Flow Neuroscience (non-invasive stimulation) are also in the 94. Science Corp's founders' past is not proof of a Musk investment.

text.style: fill:#736f69;fill-opacity:1;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-dasharray:none;opacity:1;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:400;font-family:-apple-system,'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans KR','Malgun Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;text-anchor:start;letter-spacing:-0.16px;dominant-baseline:auto;font-style:normal

svg.text: Positions are placed by this analysis from disclosed approach; Merge Labs' approach is not disclosed, so it sits in the middle.
